title: U.S. Stormwater Practice Synthesis — Research Outline

sections.title: Purpose, Scope, and How to Use This Synthesis
sections.summary: Frames this work as a synthesis of U.S. practice for research and committee review, not adopted regulation or a design manual.

sections.title: Applicability and Relationship to Permits and Local Codes
sections.summary: When criteria apply (new development, redevelopment, thresholds) and how state/local manuals interact.

sections.title: Hydrology and Design Storms
sections.summary: Return periods and storm definitions used for water quality, channel protection, and flood control.

sections.title: Design Storm Selection by Purpose
sections.summary: Separate WQ, channel, detention, and flood storms; avoid collapsing all purposes into one number.

sections.title: Runoff and Peak-Flow Calculation Methods
sections.summary: Rational Method, NRCS/TR-55, continuous simulation, and when each is required or allowed.

sections.title: Approved Hydrologic and Hydraulic Software
sections.summary: Tools commonly required or accepted for sizing and flood routing.

sections.title: Water Quality Volume and Treatment
sections.summary: Sizing basis for water-quality capture/treatment and pollutant-removal expectations.

sections.title: WQv / Treatment Volume Sizing Methods
sections.summary: Common approaches: first inch, 90th percentile, percent annual rainfall, TSS removal targets.

sections.title: Channel Protection, Detention, and Flood Control
sections.summary: Post-development peak matching, extended detention, and floodplain/channel criteria.

sections.title: Allowable Discharge and Release Rates
sections.summary: Pre- vs post-development peaks and site-specific release limits.

sections.title: Stormwater Control Measures (BMPs)
sections.summary: Approved practice categories, selection hierarchy, and sizing/design criteria.

sections.title: BMP Selection and Treatment Trains
sections.summary: How manuals prioritize infiltration, filtration, and proprietary devices.

sections.title: Facility Sizing and Design Criteria
sections.summary: Geometry, media, drawdown, setbacks, and underdrain requirements by practice type.

sections.title: Manufactured / Proprietary Treatment Devices
sections.summary: Approval lists, verification programs, and when MTDs may substitute for GI.

sections.title: Construction Stormwater and ESC

sections.title: Inspection, Operations, and Maintenance
sections.summary: Long-term O&M obligations, inspection frequency, and enforcement hooks.

sections.title: Regional and Site Constraints
sections.summary: Where national defaults must fork: climate, soils, geology, and receiving-water sensitivity.

sections.title: Plan Submittal, Review, and Variances
sections.summary: Documentation expected for approval and paths for alternatives.
